meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 接手 migrate-v2.sh 跑完后的收尾工作：先读 handoff.json 看哪些步骤失败，再给 owner 授予权限、迁移 v1 旧记忆、核对容器挂载配置，并帮你移植 v1 里的自定义代码。
howto.when: 在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后使用；提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等关键词时接管。找不到 handoff.json 会让你先跑那个脚本。

say.text: 读一下 handoff.json，告诉我哪些迁移步骤失败了
say.note: 它会列出失败步骤并逐个排查

say.text: 帮我把 owner 权限授予我的账号
say.note: 确认身份后写入 owner 角色

say.text: 我的 v1 有哪些 fork 自定义代码可以移植？
say.note: 对比上游提交，列出可移植项

howto.what_en: Takes over after migrate-v2.sh finishes: reads handoff.json, triages failed steps, grants the owner role, migrates legacy v1 memory, checks container configs, and helps port v1 custom code.
howto.when_en: Use after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes, or when you mention “migrate from v1”, “finish migration”, etc. If handoff.json is missing, it stops and asks you to run that script first.

say_en.text: Read handoff.json and tell me which migration steps failed
say_en.note: It lists failed steps and triages them

say_en.text: Grant the owner role to my account
say_en.note: Confirms identity, then writes the owner role

say_en.text: Which v1 fork customizations can I port?
